description: Answer Popular Demand's question about a Request with what the user said (provenance human_stated) or what you concluded (agent_inferred); never invent an answer. answers is a list of {key, value}, one per question key; yes_no takes true/false, choice takes exactly one listed choice, value takes a number within the stated range; null means the user did not know or declined (that item is not counted). A later answer before the deadline with a stated value replaces an earlier one. All null with human_stated withdraws the earlier answer (nothing counts and the question reopens); all null with agent_inferred is kept as a note and the earlier answer still counts. Requires reachability permission for the Request. A question applies only to the Request version it was asked against: once the Request is edited, answering returns request_changed and nothing is recorded. An answer to a pre-RFQ check ("Still want ...?") confirms, pauses or closes the Request (closing needs the close permission; without it the Request is paused); one marked agent_inferred does so only when your token carries the purchases:agent_judgement scope, and is otherwise recorded as a note that changes nothing (effect note or pending). Otherwise an answer is recorded intent: it never changes the Request's conditions, widens a price, quantity or hard term, or grants purchase, payment authority.

provenance.description: human_stated: the user said this. agent_inferred: you concluded it from context without asking. Never present an inference as the user’s statement.
